title: 流水线并行 (多 GPU 切分)

standard.summary: 将模型层切分到多个 GPU 上并行计算，实现接近线性的多卡加速比。
standard.effect: pipeline_parallel_chunks 控制微批次数量。pipeline_parallel_split_points 手动指定切分点（空=自动均衡）。
standard.whenToUse: 多 GPU 训练且模型太大单卡放不下时。
standard.avoidWhen: 单卡训练不需要。模型较小时开销不划算。

standard_en.summary: Splits the model's layers across several GPUs to compute in parallel, giving close to linear multi-card scaling.
standard_en.effect: pipeline_parallel_chunks controls the number of micro-batches. pipeline_parallel_split_points names the split points by hand (empty = balance automatically).
standard_en.whenToUse: In multi-GPU training when the model is too large to fit on one card.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed for single-card training. The overhead does not pay off on a small model.

advanced.principle: Pipeline Parallelism 将模型的不同层分配到不同 GPU 上。每个 GPU 只负责部分层的计算，层与层之间通过通信传递中间激活。pipeline_parallel_chunks 控制切分数量。split_points 允许手动指定切分位置。
advanced.intervention: 在模型构建时将 layers 按 split_points 分配到不同 device/rank。
advanced.expectedImpact: 训练速度接近线性提升（N 卡约 N 倍速）。需要 GPU 间通信。
advanced.tradeoffs: 通信开销随切分数量增加。需要足够大的 batch 来分摊通信成本。

advanced_en.principle: Pipeline Parallelism assigns different layers of the model to different GPUs. Each GPU computes only its subset of layers, passing intermediate activations between layers via communication. pipeline_parallel_chunks controls the number of splits; split_points allows manually specifying split locations.
advanced_en.intervention: At model construction, layers are assigned to different devices/ranks according to split_points.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Training speed improves near-linearly (about N-fold with N cards). Requires inter-GPU communication.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Communication overhead grows with the number of splits. Needs a large enough batch to amortize communication cost.
